For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] High-end 2D-animated Chinese donghua film style, polished battle-PV quality with crisp linework, high contrast, and extreme speed. The two teenage fighters from <Picture 1> remain exactly as established in the first frame: on the left, the black-haired boy in the red plaid jacket, white T-shirt, and dark trousers, a power-type close-range brawler; on the right, the silver-blue-haired boy in the black-and-white tech jacket, dark trousers, and red-and-white sneakers, a high-speed agility-type fighter enhanced by blue energy. Their faces, hairstyles, outfits, body types, color schemes, bearing, and left-right positions never change, never swap, and never get redesigned. The setting is a dense modern city canyon street with towering high-rises, strong one-point perspective, stylized glowing Chinese shop signs whose text stays atmospheric and not sharply legible, and a red taxi parked at the curb. The fight erupts immediately within the first second: the silver-blue-haired boy's fist, wrapped in massive crackling blue electric arcs and a blinding energy fist-wind, slams straight at the black-haired boy, who does not dodge - he sinks his shoulder, blocks with his left forearm, and counter-punches with his right fist at the same instant. The moment the two fists collide, a huge blue-white shockwave detonates outward, blasting puddle water, gravel, white air-pressure rings, and fragments in all directions; the red taxi shudders violently on its suspension, the Chinese signs swing wildly, and every glass facade flashes with reflected light. The camera starts tight on the colliding fists, then whips around the two fighters with large amplitude at fast speed in an FPV-drone-like half-circle, keeping both bodies fully readable through the impact flash. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to the black-haired boy pressing forward into a relentless close-range combo - a straight punch, an elbow strike, a knee smash, a shoulder charge - each blow trailing a white explosive fist-wind and a short supersonic crack. The silver-blue-haired boy blocks, deflects, and slides sideways at high speed, blue afterimages and electric arcs bursting under his feet with every step. The black-haired boy lands a heavy straight that hurls the silver-blue-haired boy into the red taxi, caving in the door panel; the silver-blue-haired boy instantly kicks off the car body, flips up over the black-haired boy's head trailing a long ribbon of blue energy, lands, spins, and fires a spinning kick that throws a huge blue crescent arc across the street. The camera tracks the whole exchange at fast speed, low and close, snapping from the car impact up over the flip and into the kick without losing the action. [Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to the silver-blue-haired boy's explosive counter-phase: he enters a burst state, blurring around the black-haired boy with rapid-fire straight punches, point-blank elbow strikes, knee hits, and charged energy heavy fists, his whole body wrapped in fluid lightning-like blue energy trails. The black-haired boy guards hit after hit, driven backward, his shoes dragging long skid marks across the pavement, until one massive blow smashes him into the street-side fixtures, erupting gravel, shattered signboard fragments, and dust in a single burst. The camera skims low across the ground at fast speed chasing the retreat, then surges upward through the flying debris and lingering energy afterimages. [Shot 4] At 00:09.000, the shot cuts to the black-haired boy forcing the momentum to a dead stop: he tanks the flurry, catches the silver-blue-haired boy's wrist, and wrenches him out of his high-speed rhythm - the pavement cracks open under the abrupt halt and the air itself seems to tear with a ripping pressure line. He immediately chains a heavy power combo - a gut punch, an uppercut, an elbow strike, and a final full-force frontal heavy blow that launches the silver-blue-haired boy across the street into a shop sign and the taxi, metal twisting, glass webbing with cracks, sparks, blue particles, and debris bursting together, every storefront on the street shaking with the impact. The camera pushes in at fast speed through the combo, then whips after the flying body and holds on the wreckage feedback for a beat. [Shot 5] At 00:12.000, the shot cuts to the final climax: the silver-blue-haired boy rebounds off a wall and the car roof, blue energy flaring at full output, and the black-haired boy erupts to meet him - the two collide in the center of the street in a blistering mutual barrage of clashing straight punches, crossed blocks, spinning kicks, knee strikes, and head-on heavy fists, every impact detonating huge blue-white flashes, shockwave rings, and wind-tearing speed lines. The ground splits, puddles blast upward, the taxi rocks, signs thrash, and the whole street is swept by the pressure waves. The black-haired boy finally finds the opening and lands one devastating frontal charge punch that sends the silver-blue-haired boy flying, skidding far down the street trailing a long blue energy wake - but the silver-blue-haired boy catches himself, dropping to one knee with a hand braced on the ground, not defeated. The camera threads fast through the gap between the two fighters, then pulls out to reveal the devastated street - residual electric arcs, drifting energy particles, swaying signs - and holds on the high-tension long-distance standoff between the two boys until the video ends. All motion stays smooth and continuous with no frame skipping, no freezing, and no discontinuous transformations; the action remains clearly readable at all times and the effects never fully obscure the fighters' bodies. No dialogue, no subtitles, no on-screen UI, no logos, no watermarks.

overall_soundscape: A continuous storm of combat sound fills the street: booming shockwave detonations, supersonic fist-wind cracks, crackling blue electric arcs, rushing wind from high-speed movement, and heavy body impacts. The red taxi's frame groans and its alarm chirps under the battering, glass cracks and shatters, metal twists, gravel and debris scatter, signs rattle violently, and puddle water bursts and rains back down, while the two fighters' short exerted breaths and footfalls stay sharp underneath the chaos.

non_diegetic_music: A driving high-energy battle score at a fast tempo: pounding taiko-style drums and aggressive electronic bass hits layered with rising string stabs that intensify through each exchange, cutting to a single stripped-down percussive hit on the final charge punch, then resolving into a sustained low drone under the closing standoff.
